chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad, he said:
I asked him about a man who does not know whether he has prayed two rakʿahs or four. He said: He repeats the salat (prayer).

So it does not conflict with the earlier reports, because the proper way regarding it is that we carry it upon a salat (prayer) in which doubt is not permissible, such as the morning prayer and the maghrib prayer, as we have stated before.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone doubts whether he prayed two rakʿahs or four?
ai.summary: This report addresses the ruling for one who doubts whether he has prayed two rakʿahs or four. It states repetition of the salat (prayer), then clarifies that this is understood in the case of prayers in which such doubt is not accommodated, such as fajr and maghrib.
